newsitem.title: USA: U.S. mortgage-backed spreads narrow, prices dip.
newsitem.headline: U.S. mortgage-backed spreads narrow, prices dip.

text.p: U.S. mortgage-backed securities slipped modestly in light trading on Wednesday, while spreads over Treasuries narrowed.
Mortgages were off about 1/32 to 4/32 overall late in the afternoon. Current and discount coupons fell further than premiums.
"It's extremely quiet," said one New York trader. "We've definitely hit the holiday season."
The subdued tone appears to be a trend for the next couple of weeks, with few relevant economic events expected in the last days of 1996, traders said.
"You could have something happen that would move interest rates, but you would have very few people participate in it," a trader said.
In key coupons, Ginnie Mae 30-year 7.5 percent paper was off 4/32 at 99-31/32, yielding 115 basis points over the 10-year Treasury note.
Comparable Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac certificates were off 3/32 at 99-27/32 and 100-00/32, respectively.
The 10-year note was off 7/32 at 100-11/32, yielding 6.47 percent.
